claim_scope: Qwen3.5-0.8B, RTX 4060 Laptop SM89, vLLM 0.28.1, BF16 weights and activations, greedy decode, 64 generated tokens

numerical_contract.reason: The packed kernel reconstructs every BF16 weight exactly but uses a different FP32 reduction schedule.

lifecycle_ablation.interpretation: Packing before CUDA Graph setup fixes the large service regression. JIT warmup mainly removes first-request compilation rather than changing steady-state throughput.

max_num_seqs_8_service_curve.protocol: The final candidate and closing stock use independent guarded VLLM_CACHE_ROOT values, one warmup and three measured trials, and forward/reverse batch order. The opening stock predates the cache-root guard and is retained only as the faster conservative stock envelope.
policy: At active batch 1, enable only when exact BF16 weights with stock-token drift is acceptable.
At active batch 2 or above, use stock BF16; the candidate shape guard falls back and no material gain is established.

max_num_seqs_1_diagnostic.qualification: Useful configuration diagnostic; these older traces predate the explicit VLLM_CACHE_ROOT guard, so the max_num_seqs=8 guarded qualification is the deployment authority.

memory_and_startup_tradeoff.prototype_limit: Dense tied embedding remains resident in addition to the packed cache. A production checkpoint format should load packed output-head data directly without an additive runtime conversion.

source_note: The measured utils.py differs from the canonical patch result only by one blank line; the executable code is identical. The canonical patched utils.py SHA256 remains 92ccaf39b27482411560ff194185e5a4ce6520482985f194c21eb0403949db8f.
decision: Promote the load-time packed and warmed implementation as an opt-in batch-1 weight-exact BF16 service path. Keep stock BF16 when stock-token identity is required or active batch is at least 2. This is a bounded policy winner, not a global optimum certificate.
